Kunal Kamra's Hyderabad Show Relocated Amid Right-Wing Opposition

Comedian Kunal Kamra's scheduled show in Hyderabad was relocated from its original venue to TGSRTC Kalabhavan in Secunderabad following opposition from the Bajrang Dal. The show proceeded under heavy police presence.
